conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hello. I'm Hannah, and I'm here because I've had a cough for about three days now. It started after being around my sister, who's been sick too, and now I'm coughing up some green phlegm. I've been drinking a lot of water and taking some over-the-counter cough medicine, but it hasn't really helped.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your age and gender, and describe the characteristics of your cough in more detail, such as its frequency, duration, and whether it is accompanied by any other symptoms like fever, chest pain, or difficulty breathing?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm sorry, I don't have my age with me, but I can tell you I'm a female. My cough has been going on for about three days now. It started as a gradual cough, and now I've been coughing up some green phlegm. I also have a little sore throat and some nasal congestion, but no fever or shortness of breath.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your age and confirm whether you have any known medical conditions, allergies, or medications you are currently taking?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I don't have my age with me, but I can tell you I'm a female. I do have type two diabetes, and I'm currently taking metformin, 500 milligrams. I also take hydrochlorothiazide for my blood pressure. I don't have any known allergies, but I do have seasonal allergies around springtime, which cause sneezing and a runny nose.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the color, consistency, and amount of the green phlegm you're producing? Have you noticed any chest discomfort, wheezing, or difficulty breathing with the cough?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The phlegm is green in color, and I cough it up in small amounts. It's not too thick, but I do notice it more when I cough. I haven't had any chest discomfort, wheezing, or trouble breathing with the cough.

conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your age and any recent exposure to sick individuals or potential sources of infection?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I don't have my age with me, but I was on vacation last week, and my sister was sick with similar symptoms around the same time. I think I might have caught it from her.

conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your current temperature and let me know if you've had any fever during this illness?
